eventdetail.eventDetail: Orthopedics Today Hawaii has grown into one of the best experiences in orthopedic education. For more than 10 years, it’s brought together nearly 750 attendees, faculty and exhibitors annually to exchange their vast knowledge and interest in the orthopedic specialty. We owe our success to maintaining a unique experience for our attendees. Whether you’re joining us for the first time or the eleventh, you’ll benefit from an approachable faculty, relevant discussions, intimate education and a great location. This meeting is a great size – large enough to attract top-notch speakers, yet small enough to maintain a level of intimacy. You’ll be offered opportunities to engage faculty and peers in both large and small group settings, appealing to every learning style and comfort level. Each day of the meeting offers a different focus area, so everything you want and need to learn more about is discussed and digested. More than 25 speakers will present the latest research and advances, coupled with their expert interpretation of how this information applies to your own patients and practice. The laid-back atmosphere makes it very easy to approach faculty after sessions with questions or comments.
